title: Positivity of the influence threshold
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $\varepsilon>0$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. If the total influence of $f$ is positive, then $\dfrac{\varepsilon^2}{I(f)^2}\left(\dfrac{1}{9}\right)^k>0$, where $I(f)$ denotes the total influence of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on the sign cube
The total influence of f is positive
